server_url.ui:help: Enter the base URL of your IBM Concert instance (must use HTTPS)

api_key.ui:help: API key from IBM Concert settings. Used in Authorization header as 'C_API_KEY {key}'

instance_id.ui:help: IBM Concert instance ID. This is sent in the InstanceId header for API requests

verify_ssl.ui:help: Enable SSL certificate verification (recommended: true). Disable only for testing with self-signed certificates
